issues.description: Method addGuestStudents: the problem statement UML and the solution implementation declare a single-parameter method addGuestStudents(int). In the template (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) the starter code instead declares addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput) — an extra boolean parameter. This mismatch in the public parameter list conflicts with the API described in the exercise and shown in the solution, and will confuse students who are asked to implement/use addGuestStudents(int) and expect that signature for tests or examples.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template's public API with the problem statement and solution: change the method declaration in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java to `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)` (signature with a single int). If input validation is needed for pedagogical reasons, implement validation inside that single-parameter method or provide a private helper/overload, but do not expose an extra boolean parameter in the public API described by the UML.
